 With a little help from the Rays, Baker Mayfield is ready to roll 
 The American League champs made a custom glove for the Bucs QB to protect his injured thumb.     .   Baker Mayfield has missed three games with a dislocated thumb. Thanks to the team across the bridge, he should be back Sunday in Carolina. [ JEFFEREE WOO | Times ] Rick Stroud is a sports reporter covering the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
